text: This report recommends a merit and cost-of-living adjustment for Toronto Zoo exempt staff in 2025.

The Board of Management of the Toronto Zoo: 1. Approved the staff recommendations in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (February 13, 2025) from Chief Executive Officer, Toronto Zoo. 2. Directed that Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (February 13, 2025) from Chief Executive Officer, Toronto Zoo remain confidential in its entirety as it contains information about labour relations/employee negotiations.
